programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Getafe - Sevilla 1.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Mega - Spartak
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.

programme.desc: In this documentary series, Maud Fontenoy invites us to meet these men and women who dedicate their lives to understanding the oceans to better protect them. The aim of this documentary is to discover the infinite resources that the ocean has to offer to reconnect the vital links that have always united men with the kingdom of the seas. programme.title: Blue, an ocean of solutions
programme.desc: Explorer Maud Fontenoy goes to Australia, a continent-country that has always known how to live with the sea. She sets off to discover the Great Barrier Reef. Throughout her explorations, Maud Fontenoy shares her knowledge of the ocean and the infinite resources it has to offer, in order to reconnect the vital links that unite humans to the kingdom of the seas. In the ocean there are a multitude of solutions essential to our future: oxygen, water, food, tomorrow's first aid kit, climate regulation, and even energy.

programme.title: Extreme passions

Among the notable athletes, Cédric Wane, a local champion, embodies the spirit of trail running in Polynesia. The Xterra in Polynesia is a real challenge for him. It is an experience that links sporting competition and human adventure.

programme.title: Blue, an ocean of solutions
programme.desc: My name is Maud Fontenoy. I have spent more time in my life on the oceans than on land. The ocean has always fascinated me: its vibrant breath, its sudden groans, its mysterious horizon, its sometimes dark, indecipherable sky. I resisted its rapid gusts like animals, the cold, the fatigue and the salt that burns your eyes. The sea is in my head, in my heart. I just have to close my eyes to hear its rumblings. She taught me humility and perseverance. Today I put this obstinacy at the service of its preservation. We all need the Big Blue for our survival, it is the keystone of the machinery that allows life on Earth. It's time to get to know the Ocean better.

programme.title: Extreme passions

Direction Tahiti where Pierre and his students fly above the lagoon to the neighboring islands, making the Polynesian islands an incomparable place of experience where the earth meets the sky.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix is yet another masterpiece from director Li Han-hsiang. It is a comedy surrounded the upcoming marriage of the imperial minister's daughter.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and his fiance to help escort gold to the capital. The duo run into a mysterious knight along the way and prevent bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David is falling in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming. Out of jealousy, Mona lies to him about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: A wealthy womanizer writes a diary about his romantic escapades, but the women with whom he’s been intimate have all been murdered.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: The patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: With the destruction of the Shaolin Temple, five students must each learn Shaolin techniques in order to defeat their Ching adversaries. But there's a ''traitor'' amongst them, but who is it?

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi.

programme.title: Vengeance Is A Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Paul Chang Chung plays Dr. Ho, who decides to move to a backward island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his missing father.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: When an Anti-Ching chief is killed, his family flees to a small town populated by quarreling students and formidable gym coaches. However, one teacher is also an undercover agent.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: This is a tragic tale about a young girl, played by Ivy Ling Po, who gets married and has five kids. She and her husband later die, forcing one child to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua as a swordswoman out to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the sharpest blade in the world.

programme.title: Swordsman At Large
programme.desc: Bandits, beauties, and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Lo Wei helms this poetic romance that proves a perfect showcase for Ivy Ling Po's incredible talents, as a young scholar manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter.

programme.title: Danger Has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport vampires for a living. When two of them hopped away, it is revealed that one of them is actually a man in disguise trying to escape from his enemies.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagle's own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and become patriotic heroes accidentally. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu plays the son of a police chief, who falls for a sexy dancing girl and gambles for cash. When the girl is raped he swears to defy his father and seek revenge!

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful young fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealousy and a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: The story evolves around Lin Shao-teh, a poor student who was engaged to Chien-king, the daughter of billionaire Wang Chun.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan (Yi Lei) is a compulsive gambler. He makes his wife as a down payment for his debt, feeling regretted and decides to kill himself but stops when a beautiful ghost appears.

programme.title: Village Of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying and his sister ingratiate themselves into the life of the diabolical Lin Hao, as they plot to avenge their father's death, with a little help from the lethal titular move.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: An award winning movie for best script and best editing. Another tale of a Sino-Japanese war that artistically and emotional triumphed, it clearly portrays the life of wartime.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: There is an old grudge between families among the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung. Some years later, Liang's son Hsiao-hu returns to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered. Can he avenges his brother's death?

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: The planned reburial of a town elder goes awry as the corpse resurrects into a hopping, bloodthirsty vampire, targeting everyone responsible for digging the grave. A Taoist Priest and his two disciples attempt to stop the terror.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agent Jon contemplates leaving the force until he learns his brother is working as a mercenary for a former colleague who betrayed their team.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Werder Double
programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Potrójna korona Bayernu Monachium
programme.desc: Twórcy dokumentu przypominają historyczny sezon Bayernu Monachium, w którym bawarski zespół wygrał Bundesligę, Puchar Niemiec oraz prestiżową Ligę Mistrzów.

programme.title: Najlepsi obrońcy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.

programme.title: Bundesliga Clubs
programme.desc: SC Paderborn 07Twórcy serii odsłaniają kulisy funkcjonowania klubów grających na szczeblu niemieckiej Bundesligi.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Milan - Inter Mediolan
programme.desc: Rossoneri znaleźli patent na derbowego rywala. Mogą się poszczycić bilansem pięciu wygranych i trzech remisów w ośmiu ostatnich konfrontacjach z Interem. Podrażnieni Nerazzurri mają świadomość, że muszą zrobić wszystko, co w ich mocy, by przerwać błędne koło i odzyskać panowanie w stolicy Lombardii. W hicie dziesiątej kolejki na pewno zmotywuje ich do tego spory ścisk panujący na szczycie tabeli Serie A. Jeśli Piotr Zieliński i spółka nie pokonają Milanu, ucieszą piłkarzy Lazio i Romy, którzy na obecnym etapie sezonu wyglądają na ich głównych konkurentów w wyścigu o scudetto.

programme.title: Olympique Lyon - Między legendą a teraźniejszością
programme.desc: Olympique Lyon to jeden z najsłynniejszych klubów we Francji. Jego złota era przypadła na pierwszą dekadę XXI wieku, kiedy to siedmiokrotnie sięgnął po mistrzostwo Ligue 1. Twórcy filmu przypominają tamte sukcesy i przedstawiają wyzwania obecnie stojące przed Les Gones.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: FC Porto - GD Estoril Praia
programme.desc: FC Porto, mimo słabych wyników w europejskich pucharach, imponuje formą w krajowej lidze, gdzie ma na koncie komplet dziewięciu zwycięstw. Ostatnio Smoki pokonały na wyjeździe Gil Vicente 1:0, a w najbliższym spotkaniu zmierzą się u siebie z ostatnim w tabeli GD Estoril Praia.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Olympique Marsylia - Toulouse FC
programme.desc: Gospodarze mogą pochwalić się serią trzech zwycięstw. W poprzedniej kolejce, po emocjonującym spotkaniu, pokonali Le Havre 4:3. Teraz Olympique Marsylia zmierzy się u siebie z Toulouse FC. Goście mają za sobą bezbramkowy remis z ESTAC Troyes.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Juventus FC - SSC Napoli
programme.desc: Starcie wielkich firm, które obecny sezon zaczęły zdecydowanie poniżej oczekiwań. Przetrzebiona kontuzjami Stara Dama spróbuje pokonać notującego kolejne wpadki wicemistrza. Szczególnie bolesna była przegrana Błękitnych z zajmującą ostatnie miejsce w tabeli Venezią.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.desc: E8Program poświęcony rozgrywkom niemieckiej Bundesligi. Widzowie zobaczą w nim skróty najciekawszych spotkań ostatniej kolejki ligowej, wywiady z piłkarzami i trenerami oraz fachowe analizy i komentarze ekspertów.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Atalanta BC - Parma Calcio 1913
programme.desc: Nicola Zalewski cieszy się umiarkowanym zaufaniem Maurizio Sarriego. Jednakże, gdy już dostaje od trenera szansę, z reguły nie zawodzi. Przekonamy się, czy pomoże Atalancie zdobyć punkty w starciu z Parmą.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: 1. FC Union Berlin - 1. FC Köln
programme.desc: Obie ekipy mierzyły się kilka dni wcześniej w ramach Pucharu Niemiec. Wówczas 1. FC Köln zaprezentowało się zdecydowanie lepiej i wygrało aż 5:0. Union Berlin z pewnością będzie chciał zrewanżować się przed własną publicznością. W lidze gospodarze, po bardzo słabym początku sezonu, zaczęli punktować. Wygrali jeden mecz i dwukrotnie zremisowali. Z kolei goście niedawno ulegli Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 0:1, a w poprzedniej kolejce bezbramkowo zremisowali z FC Schalke 04.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Potrójna korona Bayernu Monachium
programme.desc: Twórcy dokumentu przypominają historyczny sezon Bayernu Monachium, w którym bawarski zespół wygrał Bundesligę, Puchar Niemiec oraz prestiżową Ligę Mistrzów.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: SL Benfica - FC Alverca
programme.desc: Po dziewięciu kolejkach Benfica traci już pięć oczek do liderującego w tabeli Porto. Orły nie mogą sobie zatem pozwolić na wpadkę w konfrontacji z Alvercą. W poprzedniej kampanii dwukrotnie ograły tego rywala 2:1.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Lille OSC - RC Lens
programme.desc: Lens znajduje się na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu w Ligue1. Przedłużenie dobrej passy nie będzie jednak dla wicemistrzów Francji łatwym zadaniem. W 9. kolejce podopieczni Dino Toppmöllera mierzą się bowiem z Lille, z którym poprzednim razem przegrali wysoko 0:3.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA League: San Antonio - Minnesota
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: NBA Action
programme.desc: Weekly magazine about NBA happenings.

programme.title: Football - Spanish league: Levante - Atletico Madrid
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football - English league: Chelsea - Manchester United
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: Football - Italian league: Milan - Inter
programme.desc: Serie A is a professional football competition that consists of 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a number of great players and coaches.

programme.title: Champions League magazine
programme.desc: Overview of news and events from football fields. The Champions League Magazine show brings news about football players and favorite clubs!

programme.title: Football - Mozart Bet Superliga: Macva - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and operates according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white team is more successful.

programme.title: 1 on 1
programme.desc: Popular basketball show produced by Infinity Lighthouse with in-depth analysis of the games, and the hosts often host celebrities from the world of sports.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Crvena zvezda - Široki
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season.

programme.title: Game plan
programme.desc: The football coach and analyst will talk about how football looks and how it should look, using the example of several games from the Premier League. We will try to focus on football itself, not to leave the football field, and to give an answer to the question of what separates the teams into those that lose and those that win, that is, they often win. programme.title: Football - Argentinian League: Boca Juniors - River Plate
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league was Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is followed closely by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Washington Commanders - Philadelphia Eagles
programme.desc: The largest and most popular league of American football in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best conference teams each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet.

With the media popularization of this format, the UEFA Champions League was founded in 1992, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. Real Madrid has won the most European championship titles.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Cedevita Olimpija - Tortona
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Real Madrid - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Show
programme.desc: The French League 1 was founded in 1932 and has been attracting the attention of football lovers from all over the world ever since! Meet some of football's greatest players and recall the moves and reversals that will be talked about.

programme.title: Football - Brazilian League: Athletico PR - Vasco
programme.desc: Brasileirao Seria A is the first Brazilian league founded in 1959. Due to geographical reasons, the history of the single league in Brazil is relatively short. Only with the development of civil aviation did Brazil get a unique football league. There are currently 20 teams participating in the league in a two-round competition system. During its existence, Serie A has given the soccer world some of the best players in history. Pele, Socrates, Garrincha and Ronaldinho are just one of them. The extremely attacking and attractive orientation of the game and the fanatical and numerous support from the stands are the reason why Serie A is one of the most exciting competitions on the planet.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Cup: Buducnost Krusik - Partizan
programme.desc: The Serbian Cup is the second most important and powerful football competition in Serbia, which has been played under that name since 2006. During Yugoslavia, Serbian clubs played cup competitions with other republics of the former state, while from 1991 to 2006, Serbian and Montenegrin clubs played. After the end of the existence of the state of Serbia and Montenegro, the Cup of Serbia was created. At one time, this competition was named after the sponsor, and the final is played on one game won. The host city and the stadium of the final are known in advance.
